caveats: Known leakage: the validated encoded matrix is notebook 05's global fit (OneHotEncoder + StandardScaler on all 45,211 rows before CV), so fold validation rows influenced the encoding (AGENTS.md).
Bank's validated accounting convention is row-only sparsity; this audit reports row-only and row-or-column s side by side.
Bank is a pipeline-validation dataset, not evidence of practical quantum advantage.
Audit ridge (LSQR on CSR, no intercept, ||X|| = 1) is not notebook 05's RidgeClassifier; its scores are not the regression-fixture scores.

conventions.costs: as CFPB step 1: F60 without b, F61 as log10(M/(R N)); orders of magnitude only
conventions.margins: fold validation rows, inf-norm rescaled; standardized entries exceed 1 as-is
conventions.model: unweighted ridge, no intercept, ||X|| = 1, lam = alpha / sigma_max^2 (LSQR on CSR)
conventions.sigma_min: dense SVD of each fold's training matrix; numpy matrix_rank tolerance; 0 if rank < D (Eq. F50)
